introduction: The filmmaker and photographer was born in Birmingham, UK of Jamaican heritage. Her work focuses on raw and honest stories from real life. Her richly textured visual language draws on her experience in documentary filmmaking, radio journalism and dance, and is grounded in her love of movement and music. She places a great emphasis on her craft in her observational and emotionally moving work.
